Dedenne

Electric Fairy

Kalos · Generation 6

Dedenne is an Electric/Fairy-type Antenna Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.2 m tall and weighs 2.2 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Speed (101), with a base stat total of 431.
